text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a short newsletter blast next Thursday to drive signups for the Benchmarking webinar and to promote the new benchmark report. Target KPIs: ~3k opens, 250 signups. Need: audience split, 2 subject-line variants, creative by Tue EOD, and routing for high-intent leads into the webinar SDR queue. Who can own segmentation + send ops?
rachel: I can own segmentation. thinking a primary cohort (product folks) + a secondary cohort (platform/ops). keep the secondary smaller.
mike: For routing, let's tag anyone who clicks the CTA and fills reg form with lead_score>=60 -> webhook to salesforce queue: "Webinar - Benchmark". JD to confirm the lead score threshold.
jd: Confirmed — send webhooks for lead_score >= 60. Also want event property "email_variant" for attribution.
nora: Subject line ideas: 1) "New benchmark: How LLM inference teams cut costs 3x" 2) "Benchmark + webinar: real-world inference wins" — both short enough for mobile. A/B test 50/50.
alex: Nice. Keep subject length <= 60 chars. Also we should suppress active trial customers who already saw the report last month. Add suppression list from the report send on 1766000000.
rachel: Segmentation filters draft (will put into segment tool):
```
- country in [US,CA,UK]
- email_opt_in = true
- last_active_in_product >= 14 days
- not in suppression_list_1766000000
- role in [engineering, infra, platform, product]
```
This will give ~18k recipients. If we want smaller, we can cut by company_size < 1000.
mike: Ops checklist:
- final creative to S3 by Tue 3pm
- 2 subject lines in spreadsheet (nora)
- tracking params: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch, utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email
- webhook test to SF by Wed morning
- fallback copy for low-open segment
- schedule send window: Thur 10am PT (primary), 3pm PT (reminder to non-openers)

mkt-bot: Reminder: approved templates must pass spam-scan. Run `./spamcheck.sh creative.html` and attach report.

jd: One more ask: route registrants who answer "yes" to "Are you evaluating a self-hosted inference solution?" to the Dedicated interest queue (tag: dedicated_interest). We'll map that in the form.
nora: I'll draft the copy and experiment with two preheaders: short explainer vs stat. Preheader A: "Free benchmark + practical tips for inference cost" Preheader B: "See which configs cut token cost by 3x"
alex: Good. I'll draft the landing page CTA to include an immediate calendar add and an option to request demo. That interaction should set `intent = demo_request` in SF for routing.
rachel: Timeline recap: Tue EOD creatives, Wed morning webhook & spam checks, Wed afternoon final audience confirm, Thu 10am PT send, Thu 3pm PT reminder. I'll push a calendar invite for the send ops dry run.
mike: Quick note — for the reminder send, exclude anyone who clicked the CTA or registered.
alex: Action owners: Rachel (seg + send ops), Nora (copy + subject/preheader), Mike (webhooks + SF mapping), JD (lead scoring + routing rules), Alex (landing page + metrics). We good? :thumbsup:
rachel: Good from me. Adding tasks to the campaign board now.
mkt-bot: Campaign created: "benchmark-launch-newsletter-176777" — tracking enabled.
alex: Thanks all — will do a sync on Wed 2pm to confirm final audience and proof.
file_description: coordination thread for newsletter blast driving webinar signups, segmentation, routing, and ops checklist
